description: Accord transactions on Cassandra 6.0 per node, beside lightweight transactions: request rate, latency and errors of Accord and CAS writes, Accord paths, CPU per operation, client p99, then the AccordCoordinator, AccordReplica, AccordSystem, AccordExecutor and AccordCache families, per-table Accord repair, and node cost.
title: Accord

list.description: The clusters this dashboard shows. Clusters of one tenant share one store, so every query filters by this variable.
list.label: Cluster
list.name: cluster

list.description: Display unit for latency. The metric is emitted in microseconds, so the value is the divisor: milliseconds divides by 1000, microseconds divides by 1.
list.label: Latency unit
list.name: latency_unit

list.description: Database nodes only. Derived from a Cassandra-only metric, so control and app nodes never appear.
list.label: Host
list.name: host

panels.description: Server-side requests per second per node. CAS write is scope=CASWrite; Accord write is scope=AccordWrite, exported under its own name so it is not counted twice with scope=Write.
